name: Kingstar Eco Flex Double Layer Foam Mattress
description: Affordable 4-inch double-layer foam mattress with a printed fabric cover. A cost-effective choice backed by a 4-year foam guarantee for everyday home use.
details: The Kingstar Eco Flex Double Layer Foam Mattress is a highly affordable, value-for-money sleeping solution designed for everyday home use without compromising on basic comfort. Built with a dual-layer foam construction combining a supportive bonded foam base with a softer comfort foam layer, it offers reliable daily support at a budget-friendly price point. Finished with a smooth, non-quilted floral printed fabric cover, this 4-inch mattress comes backed by a 4-year guarantee on the foam.
